name: Beacon Lighting Group Limited
summary: Beacon Lighting Group Limited engages in the retail of lighting products in Australia and internationally. The company designs, develops, sources, imports, distributes, merchandises, markets, and sells light fittings, ceiling fans, and light globes, and electrical accessories products. It also provides pendant, bathroom, outdoor, downlight, step, smart, LED, ceiling, DIY, spot and bar, strip and cabinet, wall light and sconce, and lamp lightning products, as well as candles.
